plan.notes: Official 8-semester plan, Messiah University Department of Computing, Mathematics and Physics (cmp-8-semester-plans-2025-26.pdf), for students matriculating beginning Fall 2024. Term sequence, semester placement, and credits transcribed from the official plan; where the plan gives a Min/Max credit range the Min value is recorded, and each semester's Min-sum was verified against the plan's official semester Total row. Course titles from the official Messiah University undergraduate catalog (SmartCatalog 2025-2026). 'Professional Semester' is a section label in the source, not a course. Prerequisites not transcribed (see official catalog course descriptions). QuEST track. Semester Min totals verified: 16/15/15/15/13/17/17/15. Technical-vs-Policy option: each 'or BUSA/CRIJ/POLI' slot is CIS (Technical) or a BUSA/CRIJ/POLI course (Policy).
